Conversely, using object-centric graphs, our method focuses on task-relevant objects and relations, learns a subtask-aware reward that tracks semantic progress, and transfers effectively to policy learning.

Fig. 3. Automatic subtask discovery and sequential policy training for longhorizon tasks, using PUTSHOESINBOX as example task. The learned full-task reward is used to identify stage transitions and segment demonstrations into subtasks. Each segment is used to train a subtask-specific reward and policy, which are composed sequentially at deployment according to task progress.
